folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B295: archived source READMEs and current engine evidence
folds.body:
Five copied ER4 source READMEs were fully reviewed: [Cookie mirror](gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER4/sources/cookie-mirror/README.md), [Progress Knight](gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER4/sources/progressknight/README.md), [PlayFab SDK](gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER4/sources/trimps/Playfab/README.md), [upstream YAIRPG](gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER4/sources/upstream/README.md) and [HackTimer](gm/dispatch/engine-runtime-2026-10-14/ER4/sources/upstream/resources/js/HackTimer/README.md). They are retained archive/reference provenance, not loose project audits or new execution plans. Reviewing them supplies no new game-source/body reading, library adoption or current installed/hosted/version proof.

Keep the useful distinctions. Upstream source/master and hosted/gh-pages can differ; a content validator is partial and does not prove the built journey. Timer callbacks continuing in a hidden tab do not establish supported simulated-time transitions, boundary stops, explicit offline policy or paid outcome equivalence. A bundled client SDK is not a gameplay mechanism or a chosen cloud-save/account route. Progress Knight's described career/expense/age/prestige loop is a source of ideas, not a universal YAIR hunger, mortal ending or reset rule.

The mirror's image/sound/translation/font refresh, offsite DataDir adjustment and PR invitation are instructions for that upstream mirror, not authorization to modify pinned research inputs or contact anyone. Old dependency versions/registry snippets, TLS/platform prerequisites and editor/static-server/source-entry commands are historical documentation, not a present recommendation. Preserve authors, original links, source snapshots and licensing notices through their actual owners. Nothing is fetched, installed, updated, exported, executed or submitted by this content review.
